notes: Spiritual and druidic, graveyard-gentle: votive and mushroom-ring pieces, a family plot and a pair of ankhs, lilies and an old great oak. Core pieces are quiet woodland and votive touches; the rares are the plot, the twin ankhs and the great oak. No macabre pieces.

entries.why: Wooden votive bowl, a druid's offering
Ring of pale mushrooms, a fairy ring in the grass
Slender grave obelisk, a quiet marker
White lilies, the flower of remembrance
Great oak, the druids' sacred grove tree
Grave with red granite spire, a gentle memorial
